title: Boys and Girls
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Jan leads a women-only meeting addressing workplace obstacles faced by women, excluding Michael who attempts to participate but is rebuffed. In response, Michael organizes a separate men's meeting in the warehouse where issues such as safety, pay inequality, and unionizing are discussed. Pam shares her personal ambitions, while tensions arise around rumors and workplace dynamics. Jan warns Michael about the risks of unionizing, and conversations reveal ongoing uncertainties about career choices and relationship dynamics.
